title: Sughra ko rulata hai
body:
Sughra ko rulata hai
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
(Jab sam-e ne aata hai) x2 Ye chand-e muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham surate zehra se, bhayi ki bicharne ki. Khatune kayamat-e ki (Gar baar ujar ne ki) x2 Rudaade sunata hai, ye chaand muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kata hai gala logo, sehroz ke pyaase ka. Pamaal huwa lasha (Ahmed ke nawase ka) x2 Har ek ko batataa. ye chaand muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Taswir dikhata hai, Ahmed ke jawane ka. Har shaks ko duniya me (Karbal ki kahani ki) x2 Tafsir batataa hai, ye chaand muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal ki ziyarat-e ko, jo ankh tarap ti thi. Shabbir tere gham me (Jo ankh barasti thi) x2 Us ankh ko bhataa hai, ye chaand muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Imran ko shabbar ko, khatun kayamat ko. Haidar ki kasam mazhar (Sarkare risalat ko) x2 Turbat me rulata hai, ye chaand muharram ka
<<MINI>>
(Sughra ko rulat hai, ye chaand muharram ka) x2
